grades.quote: In order to construct this loop, the `SC.[W/D]` instruction will write the flag of its execution success (or simply the `LLbit` value seen when the `SC` instruction is executed) into the general register `rd` and return.
grades.reason: This passage answers both parts directly for LoongArch. SC only writes memory if LLbit is still 1. LLbit is cleared by ERTN (when KL0 != 1) or by another core or coherent I/O master storing to the same cache line. SC writes its success flag, which is the LLbit value it saw, into rd, so software can loop and retry.
